sentences.en: A bat flying in the sky looks like a butterfly.
sentences.zh: 在天空中飞翔的蝙蝠看起来像是一只蝴蝶。

sentences.en: Without his glasses, he is as blind as a bat.
sentences.zh: 没有眼镜的话，他就像瞎了一样（近视得很厉害）。

sentences.en: Not only the balls; the bat was also stolen yesterday.
sentences.zh: 不仅球丢了，昨天连球棒也被偷了。

senses.zh: 蝙蝠；球棒；球拍；批处理文件的扩展名
